oneOf.description: A microphone pattern that captures sound equally from all directions around the capsule.
A bidirectional microphone pattern that captures sound from the front and rear while strongly rejecting sound from the sides.
A heart-shaped directional pattern most sensitive to sound from the front, with partial rejection at the sides and strong rejection at the rear.
A more directional variant of the cardioid pattern, offering narrower front pickup and stronger side rejection but with a small rear lobe.
A highly directional pattern with an even narrower front pickup and higher side rejection, featuring a larger rear lobe than the supercardioid pattern.
